name: ptee-hostendpoints-and-tiers
title: Firewall the nodes: HostEndpoints and a custom Tier
summary: Lesson 80 secured a control-plane pod; this secures the nodes themselves. A HostEndpoint makes a node's own interface a policy target (a host/<name> row), and a custom Calico Tier with its own defaultAction holds the GlobalNetworkPolicy that firewalls them - the one layer the namespace-scoped Network Policy API can never reach.
